note: Unified enterprise capability contract catalog reconciled from PR #13 batch 1 and PR #12 batch 2.

agency.status.description: Read durable Agency Runtime health and scheduler status, including queue, playbook and H24 continuity signals. Use for diagnostics only; an unavailable runtime is returned as a technical error, never as a successful status payload.

browser.inspect.description: Inspect a live Browser Agent target. By default it returns a sanitized page snapshot; OCR evidence aliases select the screenshot/OCR path. The terminal observation is explicitly untrusted web content and the capability never mutates WordPress/site state.

browser.navigate.description: Navigate the live Browser Agent to a target URL using a bounded document-readiness mode. Returns the Browser task envelope and, when terminal, the sanitized navigation result. It changes browser navigation state but not WordPress/site state.

business.data_quality.resolve_conflicts.description: Resolve contradictory supplied facts deterministically. Facts are grouped by key and ranked by source authority, observation freshness, confidence, then a stable content tie-break. Returns the winning fact and ordered alternatives without mutating durable state.

business.decision.journal.description: Persist one immutable managerial decision with rationale, considered alternatives, evidence and expected outcome in the bounded business-intelligence journal. Replaying identical content is idempotent; reusing a decision_id for different content returns a conflict.

authority.outreach.engine.description: Maintain a bounded SEO outreach CRM for producers, wineries, restaurants, bars, associations, events and editorial partners. Use list to read stored records, or upsert to create/update one record keyed by domain+entity. Returns the stored record(s). Does not send email or mutate the public site.

operation.description: list returns every stored outreach record. upsert requires domain.

link_status.description: Sanitized status key. Runtime default is prospect.

lane_token.description: Required only when an authenticated MCP client id is present.

content.brief.compile.description: Compile a deterministic editorial brief from keyword plus optional campaign, dominant URL, SERP intent, entities, products, links, missing competitor topics, schema type and forbidden overlap. Requires keyword. Persists the brief and returns it with a content hash. Does not publish content.

content.claim.ledger.description: Persist, list, check or invalidate factual claim evidence with source, authority, confidence and expiry. Use list/check to read, upsert to store, invalidate to mark stale. Missing or stale evidence never authorizes or vetoes publishing.

claim.description: Required for check, upsert and invalidate.

content.publish.transaction.description: Create and publish WordPress content server-side with idempotency, taxonomy/Rank Math/schema, DB readback and non-blocking public/sitemap evidence. Requires title and content. Replaying the same idempotency key returns the existing post. Never rolls back a persisted mutation when public evidence is incomplete.

content.transaction.patch.description: Apply a deterministic textual patch to one existing WordPress post using replace_exact, insert_before, insert_after or append_once. Identify the post by numeric id or by a resolvable site URL. Requires an exact search anchor except for append_once. Returns hashes, change flag and optional public verification. Does not roll back a persisted write when public evidence is incomplete.

search.description: Exact anchor. Required for every operation except append_once.
